research_legs.summary: gh pr view 4056 confirms state=CLOSED, mergedAt=null, mergeCommit=null. Four comments: an automated codecov report (not a review); a first PR Sheriff review (Bella-Giraffety/nuka, 2026-06-09) finding the branch stale/conflicting/broad and reimplementing only the relevant fix as local commit a5b27969, with a full 15/15+5/5+5/5 cycle recorded; a second PR Sheriff recovery update (Bella-Giraffety/nuka, 2026-06-16) continuing a focused replacement branch and fixing remaining mail resolver gaps, with its own full 15/15+5/5+5/5 cycle; and a close comment (Bella-Giraffety, 2026-07-07T21:03:01Z) stating superseded by merged replacement PR #4417 with attribution to adensur/Maksim and original commit 6010f264 preserved.

Body: AddressToSessionIDs used strings.HasPrefix(address, "deacon"), which matched both "deacon" and "deacon/dogs/alpha" -- misrouting plugin-dispatch nudges addressed to a dog to the Deacon's own hq-deacon tmux pane. Each misrouted nudge sent an Escape keystroke via NudgeSession, interrupting fresh Deacon sessions mid-thinking and freezing them at '[Request interrupted by user]', blocking end-to-end validation of an unrelated fix (the PR body's own 'gt-097'). Proposed fix: match deacon/dogs/<name> first and resolve through session.DogSessionName, falling through to an exact-equal check for the Deacon top-level address. A real, correctly-diagnosed bug with a sound fix direction, but (per R03 below) the branch itself was not safe to merge as its own diff.
